title: Triturate
summary: TRIT'URATE, verb transitive [Latin trituro, from tritus, tero, to wear.] To rub or grind to a very fine powder, and properly to a finer powder than that made by pulverization.

inlines.v: TRIT'URATE, verb transitive [Latin trituro, from tritus, tero, to wear.] To rub or grind to a very fine powder, and properly to a finer powder than that made by pulverization.
